data.name: Clayground
data.detailed_description:
[h1]Play in a GIANT park with friends![/h1][h4]Can one Clayground park really have 24 players, 300 physics-based toys, and so many activities?? Yes, and it's free![/h4]

With our physics-based character, you can:

1. Climb everything!

2. Walk with the X button (if your joystick is broken)

3. Swing your arms to run

4. Dash and teleport (on a short cooldown)

Casual players have the freedom to play Pet Rescue, tabletop games, or socialize.

Competitive players can set up Parkour Races anywhere in the park, or play Coin Snatch to see who can snatch 3 coins first in 2-minute rounds.

Low-Ping Multiplayer: Only join lobbies hosted in your region. Then, Fusion 2 Shared Mode (basically peer-to-peer) lowers ping and increases stability.

Manual Age-Based Matchmaking: Quickplay requires you to choose one of two age groups: 13-16 or 16+.

Bye-Bye Toxicity: Mute people easily by making a 'shush' gesture. We also detect and mute rulebreakers with AI (public lobbies only).

Coming in 2026:

- Updates to Free Park's map, activities, and toys

- New parks (with unique themes and activities) as DLC. Friends play free!

- Travel to these new parks through tunnels without a single loading screen!

- Group system for visiting different lobbies with friends easily

Clayground is independently funded and published by @GamerReality on YouTube. It started July 2023, but now we're updating Clayground with player feedback until it is the absolute BEST game to play with friends in cross-platform VR.

Join our Discord for updates, challenges, giveaways, and sneak peeks!

data.short_description: Welcome to Clayground—the next-gen multiplayer VR experience where imagination knows no bounds! Whether you're a VR veteran or stepping into virtual reality for the first time, Clayground invites you to a playground like no other.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 7600 3.5 ghz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070 / 1660TI (6GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR or OpenXR
  • Additional Notes: CPU performance required for physics calculations! SSD Required, 32GB Windows Virtual Memory Cache
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i7 9700k or greater, 3.6 ghz+
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 3060ti or greater
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR or OpenXR
  • Additional Notes: CPU performance required for physics calculations! SSD Required, 32GB Windows Virtual Memory Cache
